# Multilingual fixture license notes

All six PDF pages in this directory are generated locally by `generate_fixtures.py` from original test-only sentences written for this repository. They are marked `synthetic_test_fixture` and `not_product_content` in PDF metadata.

The fixture text is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. No web page, personal file, paid content, DRM material, remote resource, macro, or third-party book excerpt is included. Tests must consume the checked local PDFs and verify their hashes against `SOURCE_MANIFEST.csv`; the generator is not run automatically by tests.
